scope: Photo renderer compile/disposal lifetime under reprepare, rapid stop, cancellation, and timeout.
constructor_overlap_probe: One-shot, synchronously restored test probe explicitly requests both passes during the vendor constructor; oldest promises are held until newer requests settle. Native rapid-stop cases do not modify upstream behavior.
program_diagnostics: Tracks native program creation/deletion, access after deletion, duplicate deletion, and deletion while a promise using that same native program remains pending. Adds no synchronizing GL queries.

independent_review: No additional demonstrated WebGLProgram ownership defect was found. Shared fullscreen geometry disposal invalidates VAOs but does not itself delete programs. No speculative renderer-wide lifetime change was made.
limitations: The Vulkan backend lacks KHR_parallel_shader_compile and reports its synchronous-compilation fallback as warnings.
Native program instrumentation may affect JavaScript timing. Independent final full-instrument and rapid-switch application checks must also remain free of errors.
This is a focused lifetime regression, not a full-instrument performance benchmark or a guarantee for every GPU/browser.
